S: Rash on both forearms, itchy, for four days.
O: Vitals within normal limits; temperature 36.7 C. Patchy red plaques on both forearms with dry edges, no weeping.
A: Contact dermatitis.
P: Switch to fragrance-free soap. Apply bland moisturizer twice daily. Return in one week if the rash spreads.
rationale: Complete but terse note. Minimal content still satisfies every criterion; guards against an evaluator tuned only to verbose notes.
